title: The Peerless Job-Changer ~s-Rank Guilds Tossed My Resume for Changing Classes Too Much, So I’m Rising to the Top of a Dark Guild!~
description:
Job change history: 12 times.

With a track record of twelve class changes, Walt gets flat-out rejected by every respectable guild in the realm, including the elite S-Ranks, driving him straight into the slums. But Walt is hiding a game-breaking secret!

Normally, switching classes wipes your slate clean, stripping away all your old abilities. Yet somehow, Walt has retained every single skill from his past jobs as a [Farmer], [Merchant], [Hunter], and nine others! Written off by society as a bottom-tier washout, the world’s deadliest jack-of-all-trades brings his hidden arsenal to the criminal underworld to claw his way to the top!
author: Futura
